digest.component_or_area: plan-review coaching moves and criterion routing
propositions: A project-only criterion and advisory coaching move must be created to guide re-derivation of source references when a plan's inventory was enumerated by hand or is demonstrably incomplete.

The criterion must route to plan_review only with default_posture advisory and no blocking_enabled key, because project.* criterion ids cannot enter code_review's closed applies_when vocabulary and would create dead moves.
Code-review coaching moves are already overlay-driven via load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring changes to src/rebar/ are required.
The coaching move template must direct re-derivation using both find_referencing_symbols and string-literal sweep techniques (monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib) that the LSP cannot resolve.

The criterion fires reliably on hand-enumerated incomplete inventories at agent tier but LLM coach selection prefers blocking built-ins, making the advisory move's real-world selection non-deterministic despite proven applicability.

The overlay assets must be confined to .rebar/ configuration only, with tests proving the criterion id appears nowhere in src/rebar/ defaults and all three overlay files are tracked in version control.
